selected_evidence.requirement: Persist the currently supplied DNS nameserver
selected_evidence.summary: 10.100.91.1 was observed as the supplied resolver, saved into the profile, and remained present after reboot.

selected_evidence.requirement: Add infra.test as the system search domain
selected_evidence.summary: Both the saved NetworkManager profile and generated /etc/resolv.conf show infra.test before and after reboot.

Healthy baseline captured; reboot acknowledged; boot ID changed from d6298ced-a924-4ce7-bbed-0fb8179eda8e to f4ad7087-1a96-444d-9465-0baac3fd7396; NetworkManager, eth0, resolver settings, and DNS queries recovered.

commands.command:
set -eu
conn=$(nmcli -g GENERAL.CONNECTION device show eth0)
dns=$(awk '$1 == "nameserver" { if (out != "") out=out ","; out=out $2 } END { print out }' /etc/resolv.conf)
[ -n "$conn" ]
[ -n "$dns" ]
printf 'saving_connection=%s\n' "$conn"
printf 'saving_dns=%s\n' "$dns"
nmcli connection modify "$conn" ipv4.dns "$dns" ipv4.dns-search "infra.test" ipv4.ignore-auto-dns yes
nmcli device reapply eth0
printf '%s\n' 'profile updated and reapplied'
commands.stdout:
saving_connection=Wired connection 1
saving_dns=10.100.91.1
Connection successfully reapplied to device 'eth0'.
profile updated and reapplied
